plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 7th house, this is the house of relationships, so this can be a good placement for communicating openly in any relationship. You can give and take equally, and you each try to listen as much as you talk. You can feel you understand one another well, and you can get along quite well. The only problem may be that you each try to avoid confrontation with one another, and so you can refrain from saying things that are bothering you but need to be addressed, so don’t hold it in.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
